_doc: Hand-written boundary cases for prompt v5 (2026-10-11). Neutral names, not from ttv2. The target is the LAST turn. expect_clauses = splitter output (exact text). expect[k].any_of = accepted normalized addressee values for clause k ("ALL" or names joined by |, sorted); forbid = names that must not be in the majority set; report_only = not counted in the pass rate.
